title: About Van — Vie Glow
description: Meet Van Ngo, the artist and teacher behind Vie Glow Academy Inc.
hero_text: Van Ngo is the artist and teacher behind Vie Glow Academy Inc. She splits her time between guiding beginners through their first tattoos and taking on a small number of fine-line client pieces herself.

blocks.title: Why she teaches
blocks.text: Van built her workshops around the idea that tattooing shouldn't feel gatekept. Using premade stencils and a safety-first curriculum, she gives complete beginners a real, guided starting point — no experience necessary.

blocks.title: Why she still tattoos
blocks.text: Alongside teaching, Van keeps a small, intentional client roster for fine-line and minimalist work — the same craft she teaches, practised at a slower, more personal pace.
